name: Octopus
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated for SIBO diets. Choose simple preparation methods to avoid triggering ingredients.
preparationTips: Tenderize by freezing overnight or beating before cooking
Boil in salted water for 45-60 minutes until tender
Grill or sauté with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, basil, or parsley
